name: Manchester Day Camp (Manchester Summer Program)
description_short: YMCA day camp at the Downtown Manchester Y. It has three programs: a state-licensed summer program for children entering grades 1-5, specialty camps for grades 3-6, and Teen Trip, a travel day camp around northern New England for grades 7-11.

refund_policy_summary: A $35 deposit per camper per week is nonrefundable. Cancel more than 6 weeks before the camp week for a full refund less the deposit; 3 to 6 weeks before, a $65 admin fee is also charged; less than 3 weeks before, no refund. Payment is due in full at registration.

source.title: Manchester Day Camp | The Granite YMCA

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, which ended in August 2026. Nothing for 2027 is posted yet. Dates and details for 2027 may change.

Registration opened at different times for different groups in 2026: returning campers on Dec 1, 2025, Y members on Jan 5, 2026, and non-members on Feb 2, 2026. Because it varied by group, it is not recorded on each session.
The page covers several programs (Downtown Summer Program, Specialty Camps, Teen Trip), each with its own grade range. The overall ages 6-16 and grades 1-11 combine all of them.
The weekly theme dates may not match the bookable units for Specialty Camps or Teen Trip.
